title: When He Comes In Glory By And By
firstLine: O, how sweet 'twill be to meet the Lord,

lines: O, how sweet 'twill be to meet the Lord,
When He comes in glory, by and by;
What a song of praise will be out poured,
When He come in glory, by and by.
We will have our robes all white as snow,
When He comes in glory, by and by;
O, be ready, with the Lord to go,
When He comes in glory, by and by.
I am longing for that happy day,
When He comes in glory, by and by;
For with Him I hope to soar away,
When He come in glory, by and by.
When He come in the sky!
When He comes in glory, by and by.
